editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: TMGM (TradeMax Global Markets) is a legitimate Australian broker scoring 6.8/10 from NAFT in 2026. Founded in 2013 in Sydney and regulated by ASIC (AFSL 436416) — a genuine Tier-1 licence — TMGM offers 12,000+ instruments across forex, stocks (DMA via IRESS), indices, commodities, and crypto through MT4, MT5, and the IRESS platform for Australian equities direct market access. Ultra-fast execution from multiple NY4 data centres provides institutional-grade infrastructure. The Edge account offers raw spreads from 0.0 pips with $7 commission. The $100 minimum deposit is reasonable. But the VFSC Vanuatu entity serving most international clients provides none of ASIC's protections — no compensation scheme, weak regulatory oversight, and leverage up to 1:500. If you are an Australian trader wanting DMA equities alongside forex with Tier-1 regulation — TMGM is excellent. If you are an international client on the Vanuatu entity — you are trusting the broker's operational integrity without a regulatory safety net.
